review.notes: Full token-level pass of all 33 physical PDF pages; physical pages 1, 3 and 8 were rendered and visually checked. The author-contribution footnote and both printed footnote URLs were dropped while their markers survived. Remaining token deltas are soft-hyphen splits, figure-internal axis labels (Figures 2, 5, 6, 9) and reference DOI/URL line-break artifacts that the markdown already joins correctly.
